//@version=5
// Solo Gen 2.0 • Isolated Omni-TF Best: 30 min
strategy("Hermes-RSI-BB-Squeeze", overlay=true)
rsi = ta.rsi(close, 9)
[basis, upper, lower] = ta.bb(close, 19, 2.12)
emaFast = ta.ema(close, 8)
emaSlow = ta.ema(close, 22)
longCond = rsi < 28 and close < lower and emaFast > emaSlow * 0.995
shortCond = rsi > 71 and close > upper and emaFast < emaSlow * 1.005
